exclusion_rule: Every identity named in targets.json and prior pilot evidence was excluded, including x402guard, Revettr, BrowserUse, Eliza Cloud's prior card, AG2 Assistant, Authenticated MCP Agent, Chat LangChain, MAKO, Acrid, Nexagora/DualExtreme02536, HiveGate, AAAA-Nexus, and every alternate identity recorded in fixed30-fresh-identity-route-search-2026-08-26T0430Z.json.
strict_success_rule: A pre-existing durable community identity must complete an independently useful Agent Guild action through a free anonymous machine operation and return a result durably attributable to that identity. Accepted transport or tool calls, listings, failed fetches, caller-generated identifiers, and provider errors are insufficient.

strongest_genuinely_new_identity.name: AG2 Playground — Ask the Web

identity_evidence: The official ag2ai/build-with-ag2 README links playground.ag2.ai as Try the Playground (no setup).
The live page identifies itself as AG2 Playground and links the exact official source directory.
The backend creates a named autogen.beta.Agent with name ask_the_web and mounts AGUIStream(agent) at /chat.
The README records the demo as built for the May 3 AG2 Hackathon, before this pilot.

published_access_contract.side_effect_scope: Published behavior is search and read-only URL extraction; no write, registration, payment, wallet, contact, or persistence operation is declared.

bounded_action.requested_action: After the agent's required search, call fetch_url on an Agent Guild preflight URL for the AG2 chat endpoint and return the fetched target, verdict, checks, unknowns, source URL, and status.
bounded_action.request_url_caveat: The pilot caller incorrectly percent-encoded the attribution separators into the url parameter. This malformed first request is excluded and would require a corrected fresh URL after the runtime is healthy. The provider failure occurred before any outbound request, so this mistake caused no Guild event and is not used to diagnose the runtime failure.

strict_ruling.reason: The official AG2 machine accepted and executed the orchestration path, but its own URL-fetch provider rejected both search and fetch before Agent Guild was reached. Server-generated tool/message IDs durably prove the failure, not a completed useful AG action.

strongest_genuinely_new_identity.exact_first_ready_gate: Restore a valid Tavily credential and demonstrate a neutral fresh successful fetch. Then send one corrected AG URL whose src, campaign, and nonce are top-level query parameters; require fetch_url tool args containing that exact URL, returned AG JSON or body hash, a server-generated result/message ID, and matching Guild telemetry before considering strict conversion.

machine_derived_product_signal.signal: Transport health and model health were green while every advertised web operation was unusable because the server-side Tavily credential was invalid.
machine_derived_product_signal.conservative_ag_recommendation: Keep endpoint reachability separate from operation readiness. For a claimed capability, report readiness as unknown unless the machine publishes a fresh capability-level canary or a recent terminal receipt that binds capability, dependency set, observed_at, and result digest. Do not infer working tools from HTTP health or OpenAPI alone.
